title: Can this asset be trusted to execute?
description: Change the bytes, algorithm, and expected-digest source. The lab computes each digest and keeps byte equality separate from publisher authenticity.

algorithms.label: SHA-256
algorithms.detail: Widely supported cryptographic integrity with a 256-bit output.

algorithms.label: SHA-384
algorithms.detail: A common SRI choice with a 384-bit output.

algorithms.label: SHA-1 (retired)
algorithms.detail: Computable for comparison, but collision resistance is broken.

expectedSources.label: Authenticated release record
expectedSources.detail: Protected HTML or a signed manifest keeps the original digest outside CDN write authority.

expectedSources.label: Digest beside the CDN asset
expectedSources.detail: The same edge authority can replace both the asset and the digest sidecar.
